content.title: Upgrade to v4.0.4 (fix Ledger/Amino signing of CosmWasm transactions)
content.description: Fixes Amino JSON (SIGN_MODE_LEGACY_AMINO_JSON) signing of CosmWasm messages. Since v4.0.0 (wasmd v0.50.0), the node rebuilds MsgExecuteContract/MsgInstantiateContract/MsgMigrateContract sign bytes with the contract message as base64 and empty funds as null, while Ledger, Keplr/Leap Amino signers and CosmJS sign inline JSON and an empty list; every Amino-signed contract transaction (marketplace buy/offer/list/transfer, mint) is rejected with 'signature verification failed'. v4.0.4 backports CosmWasm/wasmd#1844 and #1860 (both released in wasmd v0.51.0) onto wasmd v0.50.0. Binary-only: no store, parameter or state changes; the upgrade handler only runs module migrations (no version bumps). Direct-mode signing is unaffected. A coordinated upgrade is required because the fix changes which transactions pass signature verification. On-chain upgrade name: v4.0.4. Binaries and checksums in the v4.0.4 GitHub release.
